pv26:1.1: UBBARIVAGGA DUTIYO [FOOTNOTES] III CŪḶAVAGGA Abhijjamāne vārimhi Gaṅgaya idha gacchasi naggo pubbaddhapeto va mālādhārī alaṅkato, kuhiṃ gamissasi peta kattha vāso bhavissatī ti. || ||
pv26:2.1: Cundatthikaṃ gamissāmi peto so iti bhāsati antare Vāsabhagāmaṃ Bārāṇasiyā ca santike. || ||
pv26:3.1: Tañ ca disvā mahāmatto Koliyo iti vissuto sattubhattañ ca petassa pītakañ ca yugaṃ adā. || ||
pv26:4.1: Nāvāya tiṭṭhamānāya kappakassa adapāyi kappakassa padinnamhi ṭhāne petass' udissatha. || ||
pv26:5.1: Tato suvatthavasano mālādhārī alaṅkato ṭhāne ṭhit' assa petassa dakkhiṇā upakappatha; tasmā dajjetha petānaṃ anukampāya punappunan ti. || ||
pv26:6.1: Sāhunnavasanā eke aññe kesanivāsanā petā bhattāya gacchanti pakkamanti disodisaṃ. || ||
pv26:7.1: Dūre eke padhāvitvā aladdhā ca nivattare chātā pamucchitā bhantā bhūmiyaṃ paṭisumbhitā. || ||
pv26:8.1: Keci tattha papatitā bhūmiyaṃ paṭisumbhitā pubbe akatakalyāṇā aggidaḍḍhā va ātape. || ||
pv26:9.1: Mayaṃ pubbe pāpadhammā gharaṇī kulamātaro santesu deyyadhammesu dīpaṃ nākamha attano. || ||
pv26:10.1: Pahūtaṃ annapānam pi api ssu avakirīyati sammaggate pabbajite na ca kiñ ci adamhase. || ||
pv26:11.1: Akammakāmā alasā sādukāmā mahagghasā ālopapiṇḍadātāro pāṭiggahe paribhāsimhase. || ||
pv26:12.1: Te gharā tā ca dāsiyo tān' evābharaṇāni no te aññe paricārenti mayaṃ dukkhassa bhāgino. || ||
pv26:13.1: Veṇī vā avaññā honti rathakārī ca dubbhikā caṇḍālī kapaṇā honti nhāminī ca punappunaṃ. || ||
pv26:14.1: Yāni yāni nihīnāni kulāni kapaṇāni ca tesu tesv eva jāyanti esā maccharino gati. || ||
pv26:15.1: Pubbe ca katakalyāṇā dāyakā vītamaccharā saggaṃ te paripūrenti obhāsenti ca Nandanaṃ. || ||
pv26:16.1: Vejayante ca pāsāde ramitvā kāmakāmino uccākulesu jāyanti sabhogesu tato cutā. || ||
pv26:17.1: Kūṭāgāre ca pāsāde pallaṅke goṇakatthate vījitaṅgā morahatthehi kule jātā yasassino. || ||
pv26:18.1: Aṅkato aṅkaṃ gacchanti mālādhārī alaṅkatā dhātiyo upatiṭṭhanti sāyaṃ pātaṃ sukhesino. || ||
pv26:19.1: Na-y-idaṃ akatapuññānaṃ katapuññānam ev' idaṃ asokaṃ Nandanaṃ rammaṃ Tidasānaṃ mahāvanaṃ. || ||
pv26:20.1: Sukhaṃ akatapuññānaṃ idha natthi parattha ca sukhañ ca katapuññānaṃ idha c' eva parattha ca. || ||
pv26:21.1: Tesaṃ sahavyakāmānaṃ kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ bahuṃ Katapuññā hi modanti sagge bhogasamaṅgino ti. || ||
